newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish June M2 money supply up 2.4 pct -cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish June M2 money supply up 2.4 pct -cen bank.

text.p: Finland's M2 money aggregate increased 2.4 percent year-on-year in June after a 2.4 percent rise in May, the Bank of Finland said on Wednesday SPFG.
NOTE: M1 comprises currency in circulation plus cheques, giro and transaction accounts.
M2 comprises M1 and fixed-term and other bank deposits held by the public.
M3 comprises M2 plus outstanding bank certificates of deposit held by the public.
The Bank of Finland has not published targets for the money aggregates, but it has said they are among the economic indicators it monitors to quide monetary policy.
